system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: System-prompt assembly (base prompt + env block + memory + tmux/plan fragments) + prompt-injection threat scanner
system_prompt_style.note: Evidence is the v3.5.87 repo docs (tag 480e158); the paper names v3.05.79. Base prompt + model-family overlay + conditional fragments.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: Read · Write · Edit · Bash · Glob · Grep · NotebookEdit · GetDiagnostics
env_context_strategy.note: An env block and memory index are injected into the system prompt; it is unclear whether this includes a file tree.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: two-layer snip + AI summarize at 70%, and auto-fanout for oversized tool outputs

observation_format.note: No observation-conversion code in the evidence bundle. An optional playwright browser exists.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: Models that emit tool calls as **text** (`<tool_call>…</tool_call>`, `[TOOL_CALLS]…`) instead of Ollama's structured field are auto-recovered

tool_count.note: The docs are inconsistent: they state 27, 28 and 33 built-in tools. The default tool_profile is full.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: Read · Write · Edit · Bash · Glob · Grep · NotebookEdit · GetDiagnostics
edit_primitive.note: Inferred from tool names only; the Edit tool definition was not in the bundle.

tool_schema_source.note: The docs name `TOOL_SCHEMAS` in `tools/__init__.py`, but the file contents are not in the bundle. MCP tools are auto-registered.

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: MCP (Model Context Protocol) client — `config.py` loads `.mcp.json`, `client.py` speaks stdio/SSE/HTTP JSON-RPC

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: Streaming API + automatic tool-use loop; the whole loop is in `agent.py`
loop_primitives.note: Opt-in modes: /brainstorm debate, /worker, /agent autonomous loops, and the /trading pipeline.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: `TaskCreate/Update/Get/List`, sequential IDs, dependency edges, persisted to `.cheetahclaws/tasks.json`

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: Spawn typed sub-agents (coder/reviewer/researcher/…), git-worktree isolation, background mode
multi_agent_topology.note: The Agent tool is in the default full tool set; single-agent use is also possible.

human_in_loop.note: Default is auto mode, which prompts only for risky actions. on_plan is inferred from EnterPlanMode/ExitPlanMode.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: `RuntimeContext` — per-session live state (callbacks, bridge flags, plan-mode state, streaming hooks).

long_term_memory.note: Markdown skills are loaded with project→user→built-in precedence.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: sessions now **autosave every turn** (atomic write + `fsync`) so a crash or power-loss mid-conversation stays recoverable via `/resume`

self_verification.note: The evidence does not show harness-enforced verification. GetDiagnostics is a model-invoked tool.

retry_policy.note: The run loop code is not in the bundle. API retry-with-backoff exists but is a transport retry, not a task-level retry.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: Per-session and daily token/cost budgets. Checked before every API call.
termination_condition.note: The stagnation-stop guard applies to /agent autonomous loops. The max-steps setting is not shown.

cost_controls.note: Quota budgets are in quota.py. An auxiliary cheap model is used for summaries.

timeouts.note: No timeout configuration appears in the default-path evidence. The kernel sandbox wall-clock killer is opt-in.

execution_isolation.note: Also reachable: Docker image; opt-in kernel with RLIMIT+bubblewrap sandbox; git worktrees for sub-agents.

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: Still asks: overwrites, writes outside the workspace
filesystem_access.note: Workspace-scoped via permission prompts; security docs mention an fs sandbox.

network_policy.evidence_quote: Cap CPU / memory / file-size / network on a per-agent basis
network_policy.note: Net grants exist only in the opt-in kernel; the default path has no network restriction shown.

permission_model.evidence_quote: `auto` mode asks only when an action can change your files, run arbitrary code, or reach outside the session.
permission_model.note: The auto mode's shell parser and risk rules decide whether to prompt. A hard denylist also exists.

tracing.note: The kernel has observability/Prometheus and an event log, both opt-in. No OTel is shown.

guardrails.evidence_quote: a hard denylist blocks host-destroying commands in every mode
guardrails.note: context.py includes a prompt-injection threat scanner.

target_domain.note: Also covers trading, research, and MCP.

open_source.note: LICENSE file present; its text is not in the bundle.
